description: Remove a saved workspace (its API key and API URL override) from the local config. Without an alias, removes the active workspace. When the active workspace is removed and exactly one other remains, that one becomes active. Does not affect the SPLITS_API_KEY env var or any saved local EOA key — use `splits auth delete-key` to remove a local EOA.

alias.description: Workspace alias to remove. Defaults to the active workspace.

name: auth_logout
